title: Consultant Orthopaedic Surgeon
bio:
Mr Kirti Moholkar is a consultant orthopaedic surgeon at the Royal Orthopaedic Hospital in Birmingham, where he completed his training at the hospital's Knee and Shoulder Unit in 2000. He has since held fellowships and undertaken clinical work in India, Australia, the United States and the United Kingdom, and has practised for around 35 years.

His work centres on the knee and the shoulder — sports injuries in both, and the arthritic conditions that follow. He designed a surgical instrument for balancing the knee during replacement, and lectures internationally on the medial pivot point in knee replacement and on reducing post-operative pain. He also works on patient-specific guides for knee replacement surgery.

He consults at nine locations across the West Midlands and at the Royal National Orthopaedic Hospital in Stanmore, and runs the Droitwich Knee Clinic.
